from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowData(BaseModel):
    """A single cash flow data point extracted from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the report belongs to")
    report_year: int | None = Field(description="The calendar year of the report")
    period_type: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period type, e.g., 'Q1', 'Q3', 'first_half', etc.")
    period_description: str | None = Field(description="More detailed period description, e.g., '2015 Q1', 'Jan-Mar 2015'")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact metric name as written in the report")
    current_value: float | None = Field(description="The cash and cash equivalents net increase value for the current period")
    previous_value: float | None = Field(description="The same metric value from the previous comparable period, if available")
    year_over_year_change_percent: float | None = Field(description="Year-over-year percentage change, if reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit of the value, e.g., 'yuan'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the reported value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_data_points: list[CashFlowData]
